choices.content: All Dramps are Brafs and are Crups.
All Brafs are Crups and are Dramps.
All Arogs are Crups and are Dramps.
All Crups are Arogs and are Brafs.
All Arogs are Dramps and some Arogs may not be Crups.

question.prompt: In a certain land, all Arogs are Brafs, all Crups are Brafs, all Dramps are Arogs, and all Crups are Dramps. Which of the following statements is implied by these facts?

solutions.explanation: Start with any Crup. It must be a Dramp, and every Dramp is an Arog, so it must also be an Arog. Every Arog is a Braf, so this Crup is also a Braf. Since the reasoning applies to every Crup, all Crups are both Arogs and Brafs. The answer is \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
solutions.title: Follow the implications
